newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain treasury bill rate flat at 5.79 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain treasury bill rate flat at 5.79 percent.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills was unchanged at 5.79 percent, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price edged down to 98.558 from 98.559 and the minimum price accepted was 98.553.
Banks submitted bids for 16.3 million dinars worth of bills, up from 16.2 million dinars last week.
The bills, maturing on August 13, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
